content: A tree with deep, unyielding roots smiles when the tempest roars through the forest.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Gen shen ye mao (根深叶茂) — Classical Folk Saying
explanation: The foliage and fruit of a tree depend entirely on what is hidden beneath the soil. When an unseen storm strikes in the dead of night, the tree is saved not by its green leaves, but by the thick taproot anchoring into the bedrock. Cultivate what is invisible.
practicalInsight: Invest time in your hidden spiritual disciplines, quiet character, and private ethics today. They are your anchor in crisis.
reflectionPrompt: Are you spending too much energy grooming your external leaves while neglecting your inner roots?
